text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One of its main tasks is text understanding, which means a computer can read a sentence and find its meaning. NLP also makes translation possible, so we can change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a review is positive or negative. Finally, chatbots use NLP to have conversations with people and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, machines can work with language in ways that were impossible before.
